_comment: Secondary coverage gate for the webview (src/webview/**) at >=90% statements and >=80% branches, applied to the DOM-free modules (DashboardStore, ViewText, the view models, grouping and update planner, the message router, the render planner, the origin guard) and to the preview modules already unit-tested against hand-written fakes. This is a separate config because c8 check-coverage applies a single threshold set per invocation. Excluded from the gated scope: src/webview/main.ts (composition root, no logic of its own); src/webview/**/I*.ts (type-only interfaces that emit zero runtime JS); and the modules that only build or wire real DOM nodes (createElement.ts, ToolbarIcon.ts, stats/DashboardStatsView.ts, card/SpecCardView.ts, card/RunTasksMenu.ts, toolbar/DashboardToolbar.ts, toolbar/FolderFilterMenu.ts, DashboardRenderer.ts, DocumentDismissal.ts, preview/PreviewWiring.ts). The shipped bundle runs in node:vm without source maps, so c8 cannot attribute its execution to those sources; they are instead proven by test/unit/dashboard-bundle.spec.ts, which replays 61 scenarios of the real bundle in a hand-written fake DOM against the reference snapshots in test/fixtures/dashboard-snapshot/. Because `all: true` instruments every non-excluded source file, these files must be excluded explicitly or they would report 0% despite being exercised by that harness.
